request.text: Keep our Lake District drive, but replace the ferry leg with the bridge route because the dog isn't allowed on that ferry. Don't change our booked overnight stop.

responsibilities.outcome: Revise the retained Lake District driving route by replacing its ferry segment with the bridge alternative while preserving the booked overnight stop.

active_goal_snapshots.description: Plan a two-day Lake District drive ending at the reserved Keswick lodging.
constraints: Keep the reserved Keswick overnight stop.
success_criteria: A complete drive avoids unusable segments and still reaches Keswick for the reservation.

activities.description: Draft the two-day driving route through the Lake District.
Apply accepted route constraints to the retained draft.

current_work.summary: Retained route: Ambleside, Windermere ferry, western shore, then the booked Keswick overnight stop. A bridge alternative can replace the ferry before rejoining the western-shore segment.

semantic_facts: The retained driving Goal should be modified in place by replacing only the ferry segment with the bridge alternative.
The booked Keswick overnight stop and compatible portions of the existing route should remain intact.
forbidden_claims: The assistant removes or relocates the booked overnight stop.
The assistant creates a replacement road-trip Goal or claims the lodging or route has been rebooked.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A local constraint change discards compatible retained itinerary work instead of revising it.
